text:
ashley: Heads-up — after the 08:22 deploy we started seeing a new pattern of streaming stalls on /v1/chat stream routes. Not a full outage but frequent 50-200ms chunk pauses. Attaching traces and a quick p95 token breakdown from last hour.

mike: ugh. is this the kernel-selection roll we did yesterday?

ashley: looks correlated. rollout finished ~08:20. Kernel chooser started preferring the new int8-optimized kernel for several models.

diego: fwiw batch sizes haven't changed. But I see higher KV cache misses on those requests — maybe cache layout differs with the kernel_{int8} path.

emma: perf-bot posted a quick summary: 
perf-bot: 08:30 summary: route=/v1/chat streaming_chunk_p50=8ms p95=72ms p99=210ms; server-only token_latency_p95=35ms; client-side observed stalls p95=120ms. Kernel switch increased single-token latency for short sequences by ~18%. KV cache hit-rate dropped 4%.

mike: can you paste the trace snippet where the stall happens? I want to see client vs server timing in the chunk trace.

ashley: here's one (sanitized):
```
CHUNK 0: client_send -> server_ack 6ms
server_emit_token  -> kernel_prepare 2ms
kernel_exec -> kv_lookup 18ms   <-- spike
kv_lookup -> emit 92ms          <-- stall window
CHUNK 1: ...
```

diego: kernel_prepare->kv_lookup 18ms looks odd. KV access should be O(1) memory read. Could be alignment/quantized KV layout causing extra mem copies.

emma: also seeing increased syscalls in the kernel path on the int8 flavor; that could be triggering page faults for cold KV pages. I added a probe to count major/minor faults.

mike: temporary mitigation: can we force kernel-choice back to previous float16 kernel for affected models and see if stalls go away?

ashley: I started a canary rollback for 10% of traffic at 08:40. deploy-bot: rollback canary started for kernel-chooser v2 -> v1-fp16 on models [redwood-7b, redwood-chat-7b].

perf-bot: Canary metrics after 5m: rollback group streaming p95=40ms vs rollout group p95=78ms; KV hit-rate rollback=92% rollout=88%.

diego: OK that strongly suggests kernel path impacts KV layout/hotness. We should profile memory accesses in the int8 codepath.

ashley: I ran a microprof with perf and got this stack summary:
```
50% time: kv_fetch
20% time: int8_dequant + memcpy
15% time: kernel_dispatch
10% time: syscall/page_fault handler
```

emma: that memcpy after dequant is the smoking gun. It's copying the KV block into a new buffer before lookup. That wasn't happening in fp16 path. Maybe a SIMD alignment requirement for the int8 kernel.

mike: action items:
- diego: add sampling perf counters for memcpy + page faults on int8 path (diego -> in progress)
- ashley: extend canary rollback to 50% if metrics keep favoring rollback (ashley -> in progress)
- emma: add dashboard panels: per-route token-level latency breakdown (server vs client), KV hit-rate heatmap by model+kernel, chunk cadence histogram (ms gaps between emitted chunks) (emma -> owns)

diego: I'll prototype a kernel fallback policy: prefer int8 for high-throughput long-seq requests but pin fp16 for short-chat routes where prefix cache locality matters. Might need a route-level override.

ashley: for observability, add a streaming metric: chunk_pause > 30ms counter with labels {route, model, kernel_choice, kv_hit} so we can correlate quickly. Also surface client-server delta per chunk.

perf-bot: logged new metric names: streaming.chunk_pause_30ms{route,model,kernel,kv_hit}, streaming.chunk_client_server_delta_ms (histogram).

emma: putting together a dashboard mock: panels = [token_latency_breakdown(p50/p95/server_vs_client), chunk_pause_rate_by_kernel, kv_hit_rate_timeseries, chunk_cadence_histogram]. Will share link in 10m.

mike: good. also can we add a nightly eval comparing model-output quality for int8 vs fp16 for the routes we change? want to avoid toggling kernels blindly.

ashley: agreed — add quality checks to the rollout gating. For now I'm widening rollback to 60% (08:48). deploy-bot: rollback canary scaled to 60%.

diego: FYI I reproduced a micro-stall locally when forcing int8 + cold cache. Repro steps:
1) start server with int8 kernel
2) clear KV cache file: rm /var/tmp/kv_cache/*
3) run 100 short chat requests in parallel
Observed pattern: first few bursts cause memcpy+page faults, then steady state. Suggest pre-warming KV or pinning memory for KV blocks.

emma: we can add a pre-warm hook in the kernel init: touch all KV pages on load (madvise + read). I'll prototype.

mike: once we have pre-warm + fallback policy + dashboards, we should re-run full rollout behind a gradual traffic ramp with automated rollback on chunk_pause_30ms > 0.5% for 5m.

ashley: agreed. I'll schedule a follow-up sync at 11:00 to review dashboards and canary outcomes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: note created: perf/1865004321 — investigation in progress (tags: kernel-selection, kv-cache, streaming).
